PRICE_READY.label: Prix FIXEO
PRICE_READY.copy_doctrine: Show exact canonical price. No "indicatif". No range.

DIAGNOSTIC_READY.label: Diagnostic FIXEO
DIAGNOSTIC_READY.copy_doctrine: Show diagnostic price. Show absorption conditions specific to métier.

LABOUR_PLUS_PART_READY.label: Main-d'œuvre FIXEO

LABOUR_PLUS_PART_READY.copy_doctrine: Two distinct price concepts. Never sum labour + unknown part cost.

QUOTE_REQUIRED.label: Prix sur devis
QUOTE_REQUIRED.copy_doctrine: QUOTE_REQUIRED is valid. Never show fake range. Devis is the product.

ROUTE_REQUIRED.copy_doctrine: No price. Requalify client need to correct métier.

SAFETY_STOP.copy_doctrine: No price. Never show partial price after safety stop.

REQUALIFY.headline_template: Votre besoin dépasse le périmètre standard.
REQUALIFY.copy_doctrine: Suggest quote or alternative service. No experimental batch prices.
